description: LCSim is Tsinghua FIB Lab's controllable traffic simulator using a trained diffusion model. It supplies scenario-conversion scripts for Waymo, Argoverse and MOSS, a simulation notebook and a reinforcement-learning workflow for different driving styles. Inputs are converted map and trajectory scenarios, a diffusion model and configuration files; outputs are simulated motion and policy-training results. The documented training uses nine-second Waymo Open Motion v1.2 scenarios, with other coverage determined by imported scenes. Source is free under MIT and uses Python 3.10; preprocessing produces HDF5 training files. A limitation is the computational effort: the authors report approximately one week on four RTX 4090 GPUs for their 200-epoch training run. Dataset permissions remain separate. LCSim supports road-agent simulation and controlled scenario generation. Waymax (platform-waymax) provides related road-scene simulation. No dataset or weights were downloaded, and the training claim was not reproduced.
